section_summary.extract_value: This subsection describes the 28-item Mindful Eating Questionnaire (MEQ; Framson et al., 2009), its five subscales, scoring (4-point Likert, higher = greater mindful eating), and that the full-scale score was used in analyses. It reports internal consistency for the present sample (Cronbach's alpha = 0.84) and cites prior validation evidence including a negative correlation between MEQ and BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: "The 28-item Mindful Eating Questionnaire (MEQ; Framson et al., 2009) consists of five subscales... The full-scale score was the focus of the present analysis." and "Cronbach's alpha for the full scale in the present sample was strong (α = 0.84)."
